prior_expert_candidate.reason: The abstract explicitly reports a completed empirical replication study of inflammatory bowel disease linkage to chromosome 6p (IBD3) in 284 IBD affected sibling pairs from 234 families, finding a nonparametric peak multipoint LOD score of 3.0 near D6S291 that replicates the previous linkage to chromosome 6p (IBD3). In the article's reference list (lines 238-244), the primary study reporting this finding is Hampe J, Shaw SH, Saiz R et al. (1999), 'Linkage of inflammatory bowel disease to human chromosome 6p', Am J Hum Genet 65: 1647-1655 (no DOI is printed in the source text). The sole shipped row (input_row_index 611, DOI 10.1097/00054725-200008000-00016) points to Cho (2000), 'LINKAGE OF INFLAMMATORY BOWEL DISEASE TO HUMAN CHROMOSOME 6', Inflammatory Bowel Diseases 6(3): 259-261, which is a different publication by an unrelated author (Judy Cho) in a different journal and year and does not appear in Dechairo et al.'s reference list (which cites only Cho et al. 1998 on chromosomes 1p, 3q, and 4q). Report equivalence does not apply because Cho (2000) is not a preliminary report, preprint, or alternate version by the Hampe et al. (1999) author group. No prior adjudication or prior state file existed for this work.
